title: The Gate's Reflection
text: At the very source of the rift the Gate is a mirror, and in it each of you sees your House as it will be when this is over. Behind you in the glass stands the throne, empty. Something else waits in the reflection, very still, to see what you will do.

options.label: Look into the Gate, and face whatever your House is to become.

outcomes.text: In the glass your House stands strong. Whatever comes next, you have already seen it through.
The glass shows your House, then the price the throne will exact from it. You cannot look away in time.

options.label: Look away. The future can wait until the fighting is done.

outcomes.text: Whatever was in the glass, it was not for now. Your mind is clear for the fight ahead.
